item.title: China, India Among Winners After US Court Blocked Trump Tariffs
item.description: In a swift reversal of fortunes, countries that had been hardest hit by US President Donald Trump’s tariffs have emerged as the biggest winners from the Supreme Court’s decision to strike down his emergency levies.

item.title: Chubu Electric Eyes Continuum Stake at Over $1 Billion Valuation
item.description: Chubu Electric Power Co. is in advanced talks to buy a stake in India’s Continuum Green Energy Ltd. at a valuation of at least $1 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Copper Advances as US Tariff Muddle Spurs Decline in the Dollar
item.description: Copper rose for a second day as uncertainty around US tariff policy and its impact on broader markets drove a decline in the dollar.

item.title: SK Hynix Boss Pledges to Boost Output of AI Memory Chips
item.description: Chairman Chey Tae-won of SK Hynix Inc.’s parent SK Group pledged to grow production of AI memory chips to meet a surge in demand from the global data center buildout.

item.title: BofA, StanChart See Upgrade to South Africa Outlook After Budget
item.description: Finance Minister Enoch Godongwana will this week outline improvements in South Africa’s public finances that pave the way for a sovereign credit-rating outlook upgrade, a Bloomberg survey shows.

item.title: Enel to Boost US, Europe Renewables Spending in $63 Billion Plan
item.description: Enel SpA plans to deepen its commitments in the US and Europe over the next three years, with a fresh wave of investments in renewable energy projects such as wind power and battery storage.

item.title: Oil to Surge as US and Iran Appear Set for War, Fesharaki Says
item.description: Oil stands to rally strongly as war between the US and Iran looks imminent, according to energy market consultancy FGE NexantECA.
